race.comment: NINETYFIVEINAFIFTY (8) raced well last season without looking like she would win a race, and she should be a lot stronger now after time to further mature. She looks to have done just that by winning both of her tune-up jump-outs, and with a touch of luck from a tricky gate, she can crack her maiden status fresh up. LIPSTICK LEGAL (12) has been given plenty of jump-out experience before making her debut, and she will have the blinkers on for the first time. A wide gate is the query, but her stable is in form, and she deserves respect, especially if the money comes for her. SAYALERO (13) has been thereabouts thus far in her career, and she resumes from a spell that would have done her the world of good. A recent jump-out win will ensure that she will be ready to rumble fresh up. SIBUN (3) has been freshened up, and he is capable of figuring in the top 4 here.
